method: Wayback CDX roster vs live sitemap, each candidate verified by fetching the live URL
caveats: last_seen is the last ARCHIVE capture, not the closing date. The true closure falls somewhere after it, and the gap can be a year or more if the crawler lost interest.
first_seen is an upper bound on opening: a location page can postdate the site opening.
Only operators who publish a location sitemap can be tracked. CityMD, the largest operator in these markets, publishes none.
A verdict of 'closed' means the page is gone or delisted. It is strong evidence, not a filing.
